title: Could be the next big thing in note-taking apps if apple worked on it.
body:
Love the Notes app and how far it has come, but it would be a game-changer if Apple focused more on making it a better note-taking app for Apple Pencil users.

There are a few small but frustrating issues that still affect the experience. For example, when inserting or pasting images, a yellow divider line sometimes appears and breaks the flow of handwritten notes. It would be great to have the option to remove or hide this so images integrate more naturally with handwriting.

Another improvement would be a “Pencil-only” mode to prevent accidental activation of text input while writing with Apple Pencil. Also, typed text and handwriting could be better integrated so writing around text blocks feels more natural without awkward spacing or divider lines.

Finally, adding zoom support when viewing notes would help a lot. Notes written on iPad look large while writing, but when viewed later on iPhone they can appear very small and hard to read.

Apple Notes is already a great app, and with improvements like these it could easily become the best note-taking app while keeping users within Apple’s ecosystem.
